interpretation.plain_speak: The warning is early enough to support a better-timed response. Acting immediately saves 29 of 64 cases, but waiting exactly one monitoring interval saves 47. Waiting two intervals is too late—the failures arrive before either action can execute.
interpretation.north_star_question: Shows the native warning carries actionable lead-time structure, not merely imminent-failure detection.
interpretation.next_stage: freeze the one-interval-delayed two-shot rule and test transfer across the other pressure policies and monitoring cadences
